away.summary: The Winnipeg Jets are looking to build on their overtime loss to the Boston Bruins, with a focus on maintaining their fast-paced style of play. Gabriel Vilardi is expected to return to the lineup after missing practice for maintenance reasons. The Jets will use both Stuart Skinner and Clay Stevenson in the net due to the back-to-back schedule.

home.summary: The Detroit Red Wings are eager to start their 2026-27 season with a strong performance against the New York Rangers. Despite several injuries and a leadership search, the team is focused on 'early urgency' and has emphasized mental toughness and intensity. John Gibson is confirmed to start in goal, while Dylan Larkin remains sidelined.
